    c_fArcDetectionThreshold_V  : REAL := 3.20;     (* UV phototube threshold [V] *)
    c_fArcExtinctionBoost_deg   : REAL := 6.50;     (* Immediate aerodynamic pitch-up kick [deg] *)
    c_fArcPneumaticBoost_bar    : REAL := 0.45;     (* Immediate pneumatic booster pulse [bar] *)
    rArcPulseDecay              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic exponential decay envelope *)
    rIntegratedArcTime_s        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Cumulative contact loss arcing duration [s] *)
    rTotalEvaluationTime_s      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Evaluation window duration [s] *)
    tArcPersistenceTimer        : TON;              (* Debounce timer for severe continuous arc *)
    iArcIgnitionEventsTotal     : DINT := 0;

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* TUNNEL AERODYNAMIC BOW SHOCK PRE-COMPENSATOR                              *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    bTunnelEntryEdge            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTunnelZonePrev             : BOOL := FALSE;
    rTunnelCompProfile          : REAL := 0.0;
    tTunnelDecayTimer           : TON;

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* CARBON STRIP AUTO-DROP DEVICE (ADD) & WEAR INTEGRATION                    *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    c_fAddPressureThreshold_bar : REAL := 2.20;     (* ADD chamber burst drop threshold [bar] *)
    tAddPneumaticDebounce       : TON;              (* High-speed pneumatic rupture debounce *)
    rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J : REAL := 0.0;      (* Total sliding electrical/mechanical work *)
    rCarbonStripTempEst_degC    : REAL := 45.0;     (* Thermal model of carbon collector strip *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* OPERATING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) ENUMERATION & TIMERS                 *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;         (* Active FSM state register *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;              (* General state dwell timer *)
    tAscentRampTimer            : TON;              (* Controlled ascent velocity profile timer *)
    tAutoDropHoldTimer          : TON;              (* ADD latch hold timer *)
    rAscentPressureRamp_bar     : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Rolling Statistical Buffers (Window Length = 100 samples) *)
    aForceHistory               : ARRAY [1..100] OF REAL;
    iHistoryIndex               : INT := 1;
    rSumForce                   : REAL := 12000.0;
    rSumSqForce                 : REAL := 1440000.0;
    rRunningMeanForce_N         : REAL := 120.0;
    rRunningVariance            : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Internal Actuator Commands & Slew Memory *)
    rFlapDemandPrev_deg         : REAL := 0.0;
    rPressureDemandPrev_bar     : REAL := 3.50;
    rAirDensity_kgpm3           : REAL := 1.225;
    rDynamicPressure_Pa         : REAL := 0.0;
    rAerodynamicLiftCoeff       : REAL := 0.0;
    rDynamicAeroLiftForce_N     : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Alarm and Diagnostics Accumulators *)
    iHeartbeatDivider           : INT := 0;
    bBlinkerFlag                : BOOL := FALSE;
    iHardSpotImpactCount        : DINT := 0;
    rPeakVerticalAcc_mps2       : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC MECHATRONIC LOGIC EXECUTION (1.000 ms SAMPLING PERIOD)
====================================================================================================
*)

(* --- 0. HEARTBEAT PULSE & CYCLIC METRICS --- *)
iHeartbeatDivider := iHeartbeatDivider + 1;
IF iHeartbeatDivider >= 500 THEN
    bBlinkerFlag := NOT bBlinkerFlag;
    iHeartbeatDivider := 0;
END_IF;

(* Convert forward train speed from km/h to m/s *)
rTrainSpeed_mps := rTrainSpeed_kmh * 0.27777778;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 1: SAFETY INTERLOCKS & AUTO-DROP DEVICE (ADD) RAPID RETRACTION
  Meets EN 50206-1 standards for rapid contact strip venting and emergency drop.
  Monitors both external TCMS commands and carbon strip pneumatic chamber pressure.
  If the pressurized carbon strip fractures, pressure drops below 2.2 bar, forcing immediate ADD.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
tAddPneumaticDebounce(IN := (rCarbonStripPressure_bar < c_fAddPressureThreshold_bar) AND (iState >= 30), PT := T#8MS);

IF (bEmergencyLower) OR (tAddPneumaticDebounce.Q) OR (NOT bMasterEnable AND (iState > 10)) THEN
    (* Immediate de-energization and rapid exhaust *)
    bEmergencyDropTriggered := TRUE;
    rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMin_deg; (* Maximum aerodynamic down-force pitch *)
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
    bArcSuppressionActive := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* Transition directly to EMERGENCY_AUTO_DROP *)
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 2: THERMODYNAMIC AIR DENSITY & CATENARY WIRE TENSION COMPENSATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Real-time ambient air density calculation via ideal gas law *)
IF (rAmbientTemperature_degC > -50.0) AND (rAmbientTemperature_degC < 80.0) THEN
    rAirDensity_kgpm3 := c_fNominalPressure_Pa / (c_fAirGasConstant_JpkgK * (rAmbientTemperature_degC + 273.15));
ELSE
    rAirDensity_kgpm3 := 1.225; (* Fallback nominal density at 15 deg C *)
END_IF;

(* Dynamic contact wire tension calculation incorporating thermal strain *)
rEffectiveWireTension_N := c_fWireNominalTension_N * (1.0 - (c_fWireThermalExpansion * (rAmbientTemperature_degC - 20.0)));
IF rEffectiveWireTension_N < 20000.0 THEN
    rEffectiveWireTension_N := 20000.0; (* Mechanical tension minimum safety floor *)
ELSIF rEffectiveWireTension_N > 45000.0 THEN
    rEffectiveWireTension_N := 45000.0;
END_IF;

(* Transverse wave propagation velocity on the contact wire: c = sqrt(T / mu) *)
IF c_fWireLinearMass_kgpm > 0.05 THEN
    rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps := SQRT(rEffectiveWireTension_N / c_fWireLinearMass_kgpm);
ELSE
    rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps := 159.44;
END_IF;

(* Doppler Mach Number: Mc = v_train / c_wave *)
IF rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps > 10.0 THEN
    rDopplerMachNumber := rTrainSpeed_mps / rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps;
ELSE
    rDopplerMachNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;
rWaveSpeedRatio_Mach := rDopplerMachNumber;

(* Dynamic pressure calculation for aerodynamic surfaces: q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 *)
rDynamicPressure_Pa := 0.5 * rAirDensity_kgpm3 * rTrainSpeed_mps * rTrainSpeed_mps;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 3: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ISOLATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Cross-channel disparity calculation *)
rDiscrepancy_AB_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorA_N - rContactForce_SensorB_N);
rDiscrepancy_BC_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorB_N - rContactForce_SensorC_N);
rDiscrepancy_CA_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorC_N - rContactForce_SensorA_N);

(* Channel A Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_AB_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_CA_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_A := iDiscrepancyCycles_A + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorA_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_A := iDiscrepancyCycles_A - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A = 0 THEN
        bSensorA_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel B Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_AB_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_BC_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_B := iDiscrepancyCycles_B + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_B := iDiscrepancyCycles_B - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B = 0 THEN
        bSensorB_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel C Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_BC_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_CA_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_C := iDiscrepancyCycles_C + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_C := iDiscrepancyCycles_C - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C = 0 THEN
        bSensorC_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Compute Active Healthy Sensor Count *)
iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;
IF bSensorB_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;
IF bSensorC_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;

(* Graceful Degradation Selection Algorithm *)
IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    (* 3oo3 Median Value Selection (MVS) *)
    IF ((rContactForce_SensorA_N >= rContactForce_SensorB_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorA_N <= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) OR
       ((rContactForce_SensorA_N <= rContactForce_SensorB_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorA_N >= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorA_N;
    ELSIF ((rContactForce_SensorB_N >= rContactForce_SensorA_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorB_N <= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) OR
          ((rContactForce_SensorB_N <= rContactForce_SensorA_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorB_N >= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorB_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorC_N;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* 2oo2 Averaging Mode *)
    IF bSensorA_Healthy AND bSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N + rContactForce_SensorB_N);
    ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy AND bSensorC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorB_N + rContactForce_SensorC_N);
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N + rContactForce_SensorC_N);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Single Channel Degraded Mode *)
    IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorA_N;
    ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorB_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorC_N;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure: Force Fallback to Open-Loop Aerodynamic Trim *)
    rVotedContactForce_N := rRunningMeanForce_N;
END_IF;

(* Update Sensor Noise Variances via Exponential Smoothing *)
rSensorVarA := (0.98 * rSensorVarA) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorA_N - rVotedContactForce_N));
rSensorVarB := (0.98 * rSensorVarB) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorB_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorB_N - rVotedContactForce_N));
rSensorVarC := (0.98 * rSensorVarC) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorC_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorC_N - rVotedContactForce_N));

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 4: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER STATE OBSERVER
  Estimates the full 6-dimensional internal state vector from noisy sensor inputs.
  States: x = [z1, dz1, z2, dz2, Fc, P_bellows]^T
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rInno_1 : REAL;
    rInno_2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_z1 : REAL;
    rStatePred_dz1 : REAL;
    rStatePred_z2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_dz2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_Fc : REAL;
    rStatePred_Pb : REAL;
END_VAR

(* Step 4.1: Compute Innovations: residual = y - y_pred *)
rInno_1 := rVotedContactForce_N - rStateEst_Fc_N;
rInno_2 := rMainBellowsPressure_bar - rStateEst_Pbellows_bar;

(* Step 4.2: Time Propagation / State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
rStatePred_z1 := (Ad_11 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_12 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_13 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_14 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_15 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_16 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_11 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_12 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_dz1 := (Ad_21 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_22 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_23 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_24 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_25 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_26 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_21 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_22 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_z2 := (Ad_31 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_32 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_33 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_34 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_35 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_36 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_31 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_32 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_dz2 := (Ad_41 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_42 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_43 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_44 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_45 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_46 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_41 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_42 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_Fc := (Ad_51 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_52 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_53 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_54 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_55 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_56 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_51 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_52 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_Pb := (Ad_61 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_62 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_63 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_64 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_65 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_66 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_61 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_62 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);

(* Step 4.3: Measurement Update: x_est = x_pred + Lk * Innovation *)
rStateEst_z1_m := rStatePred_z1 + (Lk_11 * rInno_1) + (Lk_12 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_dz1_mps := rStatePred_dz1 + (Lk_21 * rInno_1) + (Lk_22 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_z2_m := rStatePred_z2 + (Lk_31 * rInno_1) + (Lk_32 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_dz2_mps := rStatePred_dz2 + (Lk_41 * rInno_1) + (Lk_42 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_Fc_N := rStatePred_Fc + (Lk_51 * rInno_1) + (Lk_52 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_Pbellows_bar := rStatePred_Pb + (Lk_61 * rInno_1) + (Lk_62 * rInno_2);

(* Assigned Validated Output *)
rEstimatedContactForce_N := rStateEst_Fc_N;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 5: TARGET UPLIFT FORCE COMPUTATION (EN 50367 / TSI HIGH SPEED REGULATION)
  Normative formula: Fm = 70 + 0.00097 * v^2 [N]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
rTargetContactForce_N := 70.0 + (0.00097 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
IF rTargetContactForce_N > 280.0 THEN
    rTargetContactForce_N := 280.0; (* Upper ceiling for aerodynamic uplift *)
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING
  Solves optimal control increments dU = [d_alpha, d_P] to eliminate contact force tracking error.
  Implements Hildreth's Dual Quadratic Programming algorithm over box constraints.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rForceTrackingError_N : REAL;
    rPressureTrackingError_bar : REAL;
    rStaticBellowsTarget_bar : REAL;
    rRawDeltaAlpha : REAL;
    rRawDeltaPneu : REAL;
    iIter : INT;
    rLagrangeStep : REAL;
END_VAR

rForceTrackingError_N := rEstimatedContactForce_N - rTargetContactForce_N;

(* Quasi-static bellows target pressure based on train speed uplift equilibrium *)
rStaticBellowsTarget_bar := 3.20 + (0.000015 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
IF rStaticBellowsTarget_bar > 5.50 THEN
    rStaticBellowsTarget_bar := 5.50;
END_IF;
rPressureTrackingError_bar := rStateEst_Pbellows_bar - rStaticBellowsTarget_bar;

(* Compute Linear Gradient Vectors: g = M_err^T * Q * Error *)
rMpcGrad_1 := (1.8542 * rForceTrackingError_N) + (0.1245 * rStateEst_dz1_mps * 100.0);
rMpcGrad_2 := (0.4215 * rForceTrackingError_N) + (24.502 * rPressureTrackingError_bar);
rMpcGrad_3 := 0.6520 * rMpcGrad_1;
rMpcGrad_4 := 0.7015 * rMpcGrad_2;

(* Unconstrained QP Solution: dU_opt = -H_inv * g *)
rRawDeltaAlpha := -((Hinv_11 * rMpcGrad_1) + (Hinv_12 * rMpcGrad_2) + (Hinv_13 * rMpcGrad_3) + (Hinv_14 * rMpcGrad_4));
rRawDeltaPneu  := -((Hinv_21 * rMpcGrad_1) + (Hinv_22 * rMpcGrad_2) + (Hinv_23 * rMpcGrad_3) + (Hinv_24 * rMpcGrad_4));

(* Hildreth Dual Active-Set Projected Iterations for Box Slew Constraints *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO c_iHildrethMaxIterations DO
    (* Multiplier 1: Upper slew bound on flap *)
    rLagrangeStep := rRawDeltaAlpha - (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[1] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[1] := aLagrangeLambda[1] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[1] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 2: Lower slew bound on flap *)
    rLagrangeStep := -(rRawDeltaAlpha) - (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[2] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[2] := aLagrangeLambda[2] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[2] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 3: Upper slew bound on pressure *)
    rLagrangeStep := rRawDeltaPneu - (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[3] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[3] := aLagrangeLambda[3] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[3] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 4: Lower slew bound on pressure *)
    rLagrangeStep := -(rRawDeltaPneu) - (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[4] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[4] := aLagrangeLambda[4] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[4] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Result *)
rDeltaU_Opt_1 := rRawDeltaAlpha - (Hinv_11 * (aLagrangeLambda[1] - aLagrangeLambda[2]));
rDeltaU_Opt_2 := rRawDeltaPneu - (Hinv_22 * (aLagrangeLambda[3] - aLagrangeLambda[4]));

(* Saturated Hard Limit Checks *)
IF rDeltaU_Opt_1 > (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_1 := c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s;
ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_1 < -(c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_1 := -(c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
END_IF;

IF rDeltaU_Opt_2 > (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_2 := c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s;
ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_2 < -(c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_2 := -(c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 7: CATENARY WAVE SPEED DOPPLER DAMPING (ANTI-RESONANCE BI-QUAD FILTER)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Compute Dropper Passage Excitation Frequency: f = v / L_dropper *)
IF c_fDropperSpacing_m > 1.0 THEN
    rDropperFrequency_Hz := rTrainSpeed_mps / c_fDropperSpacing_m;
ELSE
    rDropperFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute Mast Span Passage Frequency: f_span = v / L_span *)
IF c_fSpanLength_m > 10.0 THEN
    rSpanFrequency_Hz := rTrainSpeed_mps / c_fSpanLength_m;
ELSE
    rSpanFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Doppler Amplification Compensation Gain *)
IF rDopplerMachNumber < 0.90 THEN
    rDopplerDampingGain := 1.0 / (1.0 - (0.85 * rDopplerMachNumber));
ELSE
    rDopplerDampingGain := 4.25; (* Clamped ceiling to prevent loop instability near sound speed *)
END_IF;

(* Update Bi-Quad Resonant Filter tuned to Dropper Frequency Harmonic *)
(* Canonical Direct Form II Transposed Structure *)
rBiquad_y := (rBiquad_b0 * rForceTrackingError_N) + rBiquad_x1;
rBiquad_x1 := (rBiquad_b1 * rForceTrackingError_N) - (rBiquad_a1 * rBiquad_y) + rBiquad_x2;
rBiquad_x2 := (rBiquad_b2 * rForceTrackingError_N) - (rBiquad_a2 * rBiquad_y);

(* Anti-Phase Dynamic Torque Generation for Pitch Frame Damping *)
rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := -1.0 * rDopplerDampingGain * (rBiquad_y * 0.45);
IF rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm > 150.0 THEN
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 150.0;
ELSIF rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm < -150.0 THEN
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := -150.0;
END_IF;

(* Online Dropper Harmonic Power Tracking via Goertzel Algorithm *)
rGoertzel_s0 := rForceTrackingError_N + (1.854 * rGoertzel_s1) - rGoertzel_s2;
rGoertzel_s2 := rGoertzel_s1;
rGoertzel_s1 := rGoertzel_s0;
iGoertzelSampleCount := iGoertzelSampleCount + 1;
IF iGoertzelSampleCount >= 64 THEN
    rDropperHarmonicPower_W := (rGoertzel_s1 * rGoertzel_s1) + (rGoertzel_s2 * rGoertzel_s2) - (1.854 * rGoertzel_s1 * rGoertzel_s2);
    rGoertzel_s0 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s1 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s2 := 0.0;
    iGoertzelSampleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 8: OPTICAL CONTACT ARC EXTINCTION VIA HIGH-SPEED DYNAMIC RE-ENGAGEMENT
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
rTotalEvaluationTime_s := rTotalEvaluationTime_s + c_fSampleTime_s;

(* Arc Detection via UV Sensor Voltage Threshold *)
IF (rOpticalArcSensorUV_V >= c_fArcDetectionThreshold_V) AND (rCatenaryVoltage_V > 10000.0) THEN
    rIntegratedArcTime_s := rIntegratedArcTime_s + c_fSampleTime_s;
    iArcIgnitionEventsTotal := iArcIgnitionEventsTotal + 1;
    bArcSuppressionActive := TRUE;
    (* Trigger Instantaneous Aerodynamic Pitch-Up Boost *)
    rArcPulseDecay := c_fArcExtinctionBoost_deg;
ELSE
    (* Exponential Decay of Arc Extinction Pulse (tau ~ 12 ms) *)
    IF rArcPulseDecay > 0.05 THEN
        rArcPulseDecay := rArcPulseDecay * 0.92;
    ELSE
        rArcPulseDecay := 0.0;
        bArcSuppressionActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Running Contact Loss Percentage NQ (EN 50367 / EN 50318 standard) *)
IF rTotalEvaluationTime_s >= 10.0 THEN
    rContactLossRatio_NQ := (rIntegratedArcTime_s / rTotalEvaluationTime_s) * 100.0;
    (* Reset sliding window periodically *)
    rIntegratedArcTime_s := rIntegratedArcTime_s * 0.5;
    rTotalEvaluationTime_s := rTotalEvaluationTime_s * 0.5;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 9: TUNNEL AERODYNAMIC BOW SHOCK FEEDFORWARD COMPENSATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
bTunnelEntryEdge := bTunnelEntryZone AND NOT bTunnelZonePrev;
bTunnelZonePrev := bTunnelEntryZone;

IF bTunnelEntryEdge THEN
    (* Inject forward pitch downfeed to counteract the intense aerodynamic nose shock *)
    rTunnelCompProfile := -3.50 * (rTrainSpeed_kmh / 400.0) * (rTrainSpeed_kmh / 400.0);
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

IF rTunnelCompProfile < -0.05 THEN
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2500MS);
    rTunnelCompProfile := rTunnelCompProfile * 0.995;
    IF tTunnelDecayTimer.Q THEN
        rTunnelCompProfile := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTunnelCompProfile := 0.0;
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 10: COLLECTOR STRIP THERMAL DYNAMICS & CUMULATIVE WEAR INTEGRATOR
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Frictional and Joule heating dissipation *)
rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J := rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J + (rEstimatedContactForce_N * rTrainSpeed_mps * 0.12 * c_fSampleTime_s);
rCarbonStripTempEst_degC := (0.9998 * rCarbonStripTempEst_degC) + (0.0002 * (rAmbientTemperature_degC + (0.0015 * rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J * 0.001)));

(* Cumulative carbon wear percentage estimation (100% = 25 mm allowable wear depth) *)
rEstimatedStripWear_pct := (rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J / 450000000.0) * 100.0;
IF rEstimatedStripWear_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rEstimatedStripWear_pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 11: MULTI-STAGE OPERATING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* FSM_STATE: UNINITIALIZED_SELF_TEST *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := FALSE;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10; (* Transition to STANDBY_LOWERED *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* FSM_STATE: STANDBY_LOWERED *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := FALSE;
        
        IF bMasterEnable AND NOT bEmergencyLower THEN
            iState := 20; (* Advance to PRE_PRESSURIZATION *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* FSM_STATE: PRE_PRESSURIZATION *)
        (* Fill pneumatic bellows to baseline threshold before mechanical latch release *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 1.80;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := (rMainBellowsPressure_bar >= 1.65), PT := T#800MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAscentPressureRamp_bar := 1.80;
            iState := 30; (* Advance to CONTROLLED_ASCENT *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    30: (* FSM_STATE: CONTROLLED_ASCENT *)
        (* Smooth pneumatic ramp-up to ensure soft contact with catenary wire (< 1.5 m/s) *)
        rAscentPressureRamp_bar := rAscentPressureRamp_bar + (0.85 * c_fSampleTime_s);
        IF rAscentPressureRamp_bar > 4.20 THEN
            rAscentPressureRamp_bar := 4.20;
        END_IF;
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rAscentPressureRamp_bar;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        (* Detect wire contact when contact force exceeds 40 N continuously *)
        tStateTimer(IN := (rEstimatedContactForce_N >= 40.0), PT := T#250MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Advance to CATENARY_ACQUISITION_AND_LATCH *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    40: (* FSM_STATE: CATENARY_ACQUISITION_AND_LATCH *)
        (* Stabilize contact force at nominal baseline *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 3.20;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := (rEstimatedContactForce_N >= 60.0) AND (rEstimatedContactForce_N <= 150.0), PT := T#1200MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
                iState := 60; (* HIGH_SPEED_DOPPLER_TRACKING *)
            ELSE
                iState := 50; (* SUB_CRITICAL_REGULATION *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    50: (* FSM_STATE: SUB_CRITICAL_REGULATION (0 .. 250 km/h) *)
        (* Pneumatic bellows drives slow force tracking, flaps compensate local irregularities *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + rDeltaU_Opt_2;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + (0.50 * rDeltaU_Opt_1) + rArcPulseDecay + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF rTrainSpeed_kmh > 260.0 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to high-speed mode *)
        ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 0 THEN
            iState := 90; (* Sensor failure degraded mode *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* FSM_STATE: HIGH_SPEED_DOPPLER_TRACKING (250 .. 450+ km/h) *)
        (* Full mechatronic bandwidth: active aerodynamic flaps handle 2..30 Hz, bellows handle < 2 Hz *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + rDeltaU_Opt_2;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + rDeltaU_Opt_1 + rArcPulseDecay + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF bTunnelEntryZone THEN
            iState := 70; (* Tunnel transient state *)
        ELSIF bArcSuppressionActive THEN
            iState := 80; (* Optical arc quench state *)
        ELSIF rTrainSpeed_kmh < 240.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Drop back to sub-critical *)
        ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 0 THEN
            iState := 90; (* Degraded passive mode *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* FSM_STATE: TUNNEL_PRESSURE_WAVE_TRANSIENT *)
        (* Extreme aerodynamic pitch command to resist portal shock wave *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + (0.80 * rDeltaU_Opt_2);
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + rDeltaU_Opt_1 + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF NOT bTunnelEntryZone AND (rTunnelCompProfile >= -0.05) THEN
            IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
                iState := 60;
            ELSE
                iState := 50;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* FSM_STATE: OPTICAL_ARC_QUENCH_OVERDRIVE *)
        (* Fast active re-engagement burst *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + c_fArcPneumaticBoost_bar;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + rArcPulseDecay;
        
        IF NOT bArcSuppressionActive AND (rArcPulseDecay <= 0.05) THEN
            IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
                iState := 60;
            ELSE
                iState := 50;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    90: (* FSM_STATE: SENSOR_DEGRADED_PASSIVE_TRIM *)
        (* Open-loop velocity-scheduled aerodynamic flap schedule and nominal pneumatic pressure *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 3.50 + (0.000012 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 1.20 - (0.000025 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        
        IF iHealthySensorCount >= 2 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Recovered sensor redundancy *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* FSM_STATE: EMERGENCY_AUTO_DROP *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMin_deg;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := TRUE;
        
        tAutoDropHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4000MS);
        IF tAutoDropHoldTimer.Q AND NOT bEmergencyLower AND (rEstimatedContactForce_N <= 5.0) THEN
            tAutoDropHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bEmergencyDropTriggered := FALSE;
            iState := 10; (* Return to standby lowered *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* FSM_STATE: HARD_FAULT_LOCKOUT *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMin_deg;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := TRUE;
        
        (* Lockout requires master enable cycle and fault reset *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iState := 110; (* Safe fallback on undefined state *)
END_CASE;

iCurrentOperatingState := iState;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 12: ACTUATOR OUTPUT SATURATION & SLEW-RATE LIMITING
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Aerodynamic Flap Angle Bounds *)
IF rAeroFlapDemand_deg > c_fFlapAngleMax_deg THEN
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMax_deg;
ELSIF rAeroFlapDemand_deg < c_fFlapAngleMin_deg THEN
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMin_deg;
END_IF;

(* Aerodynamic Flap Slew-Rate Limiter *)
IF (rAeroFlapDemand_deg - rFlapDemandPrev_deg) > (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
ELSIF (rAeroFlapDemand_deg - rFlapDemandPrev_deg) < -(c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg - (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
END_IF;
rFlapDemandPrev_deg := rAeroFlapDemand_deg;

(* Pneumatic Bellows Pressure Demand Bounds *)
IF rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar > c_fPressureMax_bar THEN
    rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := c_fPressureMax_bar;
ELSIF (rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar < c_fPressureMin_bar) AND (iState /= 100) AND (iState /= 110) AND (iState /= 10) AND (iState /= 0) THEN
    rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := c_fPressureMin_bar;
ELSIF rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar < 0.0 THEN
    rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Pneumatic Slew-Rate Limiter (Only active during normal tracking states) *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) THEN
    IF (rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar - rPressureDemandPrev_bar) > (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    ELSIF (rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar - rPressureDemandPrev_bar) < -(c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar - (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rPressureDemandPrev_bar := rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 13: ROLLING STATISTICAL ESTIMATION (SIGMA & CONTACT QUALITY METRICS)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Update 100-sample ring buffer for dynamic contact force standard deviation *)
rSumForce := rSumForce - aForceHistory[iHistoryIndex] + rEstimatedContactForce_N;
rSumSqForce := rSumSqForce - (aForceHistory[iHistoryIndex] * aForceHistory[iHistoryIndex]) + (rEstimatedContactForce_N * rEstimatedContactForce_N);
aForceHistory[iHistoryIndex] := rEstimatedContactForce_N;

iHistoryIndex := iHistoryIndex + 1;
IF iHistoryIndex > 100 THEN
    iHistoryIndex := 1;
END_IF;

rRunningMeanForce_N := rSumForce * 0.01;
rRunningVariance := (rSumSqForce * 0.01) - (rRunningMeanForce_N * rRunningMeanForce_N);
IF rRunningVariance > 0.1 THEN
    rStandardDeviation_N := SQRT(rRunningVariance);
ELSE
    rStandardDeviation_N := 0.0;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 14: ALARM TREE & DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM STATUS BITMAPPING
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Reset Alarm and Status words *)
wAlarmWord := 16#0000;
wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;

(* --- ALARM WORD EVALUATION --- *)
(* Bit 0: Dynamic Over-Force Safety Limit Exceeded (> 350 N per EN 50367) *)
IF rEstimatedContactForce_N > 350.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 1: Dynamic Under-Force / Severe Contact Loss (< 15 N) *)
IF (rEstimatedContactForce_N < 15.0) AND (iState >= 50) AND (iState <= 80) THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 2: Sensor Channel A Fault / Isolation *)
IF NOT bSensorA_Healthy THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 3: Sensor Channel B Fault / Isolation *)
IF NOT bSensorB_Healthy THEN
    wAlarmWord.3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 4: Sensor Channel C Fault / Isolation *)
IF NOT bSensorC_Healthy THEN
    wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 5: 2oo3 TMR Complete Failure (All Load Cells Failed) *)
IF iHealthySensorCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.5 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 6: Optical Contact Loss Arcing Ratio Exceeded (NQ > 0.10%) *)
IF rContactLossRatio_NQ > 0.10 THEN
    wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 7: Critical Catenary Wave Mach Number (Mc > 0.82) *)
IF rDopplerMachNumber > 0.82 THEN
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 8: Aerodynamic Flap Servo Angle Saturation Limit Reached *)
IF (rAeroFlapDemand_deg >= c_fFlapAngleMax_deg) OR (rAeroFlapDemand_deg <= c_fFlapAngleMin_deg) THEN
    wAlarmWord.8 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 9: Pneumatic Bellows Pressure Anomaly *)
IF (rMainBellowsPressure_bar < 1.0) AND (iState >= 30) AND (iState <= 80) THEN
    wAlarmWord.9 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 10: Excessive Panhead Vertical Acceleration (Hard-Spot Impact > 45 m/s2) *)
IF ABS(rVerticalAcceleration_mps2) > 45.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.10 := TRUE;
    iHardSpotImpactCount := iHardSpotImpactCount + 1;
END_IF;

(* Bit 11: Tunnel Aerodynamic Shock Wave Compensation Active *)
IF bTunnelEntryZone THEN
    wAlarmWord.11 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 12: High Crosswind Aerodynamic Disturbance (> 25 m/s) *)
IF rCrossWindSpeed_mps > 25.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.12 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 13: Emergency Auto-Drop Device Triggered *)
IF bEmergencyDropTriggered THEN
    wAlarmWord.13 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Degraded Control Mode Active *)
IF (iState = 90) OR (iHealthySensorCount < 3) THEN
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 15: Critical Safety Trip Active *)
IF (wAlarmWord.0) OR (wAlarmWord.5) OR (bEmergencyDropTriggered) THEN
    wAlarmWord.15 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- SYSTEM STATUS WORD EVALUATION --- *)
(* Bit 0: System Master Initialized and Healthy *)
IF (iState > 0) AND NOT wAlarmWord.15 THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.0 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 1: Pantograph Raised and Latched onto Overhead Wire *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (iState <= 90) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.1 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 2: High-Bandwidth Aerodynamic Flap Servo Active *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) OR (iState = 80) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.2 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 3: Electro-Pneumatic Bellows Closed-Loop Active *)
IF (iState >= 30) AND (iState <= 90) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 4: Doppler Anti-Resonant Damping Engaged *)
IF (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.4 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 5: Optical Arc Extinction System Armed *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (iState <= 80) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.5 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 6: 2oo3 TMR Triple Redundancy 100% Nominal (3 Sensors OK) *)
IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.6 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 7: 2oo3 TMR Operating in Degraded Mode (1 or 2 Sensors Failed) *)
IF (iHealthySensorCount > 0) AND (iHealthySensorCount < 3) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.7 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 8: High-Speed Operational Regime Active (> 250 km/h) *)
IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.8 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 9: Ultra-High-Speed Transonic Catenary Regime Active (> 380 km/h) *)
IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 380.0 THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.9 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 10: Arc Quench Pulse Active *)
IF bArcSuppressionActive THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.10 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 11: Tunnel Feedforward Active *)
IF (rTunnelCompProfile < -0.05) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.11 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 12: Standard Deviation Compliant with TSI Norm (sigma <= 0.20 * Target) *)
IF (rStandardDeviation_N <= (0.20 * rTargetContactForce_N)) AND (rStandardDeviation_N > 0.1) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.12 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 13: Ice Scraping Increased Uplift Mode Available *)
IF rAmbientTemperature_degC < 0.0 THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.13 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Maintenance Advisory Flag (Contact Strip / Aerodynamic Slew Check) *)
IF (iHardSpotImpactCount > 100) OR (rContactLossRatio_NQ > 0.08) OR (rEstimatedStripWear_pct > 80.0) THEN
    wSystemStatusWord.14 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bit 15: Cyclic Mechatronic Heartbeat Toggle (0.5 Hz) *)
wSystemStatusWord.15 := bBlinkerFlag;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
